row: Health and wellness have been the total focus of WellSpring since the school's founding in 1988. While massage therapy was the original focus of the school, today we have a state-of-the-art programs in Medical Assisting, Personal Training & Wellness  that prepares graduates to be certified as a Personal Trainer and to compete for openings at top health clubs and fitness centers across the country.
